artifacts.summary: Root-causes the hang to synthesize_citekeys()'s O(n^2)-shaped per-item bash loop in zotero-generate-export.sh (not stdin/network as hypothesized); confirms via microbenchmark and a live ~122s uncontended reproduction of the failing short-mid-page scenario; recommends a bulk-jq rewrite plus a bounded test timeout with a deliberately-stalled fixture to prove it fires.

memory_candidates.content: Bash anti-pattern found in zotero-generate-export.sh's synthesize_citekeys(): looping over an array with `for (( i=0; i<count; i++ ))` and, per iteration, re-parsing the whole source array via `echo "$items_json" | jq -c ".[$i]"` and re-serializing the whole growing result via `echo "$result" | jq --argjson e "$entry" '. + [$e]'` is O(n) jq subprocess spawns each doing O(n) JSON work -- effectively quadratic wall-clock cost. At n=2828 this measured ~122s uncontended (microbenchmark: n=50->2s ... n=2000->81s, clearly superlinear). Looks exactly like a hang under a short timeout or under heavy CPU contention (confirmed: explains a live 24-minute observation under load avg ~40/24 cores) even though it is not blocking I/O at all. Fix: do the whole array in a single bulk jq invocation (reduce/group_by) instead of a bash per-item loop.
